records.title: Founder Office Determinations: NOT ESTABLISHED Obligation Disposition, Supersession Non-Cascade, and the Expiration Distinction

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One Discovery Closed, Discovery Report Admitted, Stage 2 Authorized
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 2: Provisional Organizational Diagnostic Method execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), accepting and closing Generation One discovery, admitting the Discovery Report as an evidentiary Institutional Record, fixing the proposed progression as a refinement proposal to mr-0004, determining evidence sufficiency without external validity, authorizing bounded historical-instrument retrieval and a bounded HGP evidence-admission package, classifying Curbside Spa as an internal idea rather than client evidence, refining the institutional-memory principle to be mechanism-neutral, and authorizing the Organizational Diagnostic as a working concept advancing toward draft with ten provisional working instruments and a frozen-draft self-application dry run

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Systems Methodology — Stage 2 Accepted, Stage 3 Authorized, HGP Evidence Admitted, Founder Office Instrument Preservation
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 3: Organizational Diagnostic Draft v2 + First Stakeholder-Evidence Application execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), accepting Stage 2 as complete, ordering Draft v1 preserved as the frozen tested baseline, admitting the HGP-derived lessons actually relied upon as provisional evidentiary methodology support through the FD-V1 §14 boundary, determining that institutionally significant Founder Office instruments are preserved through existing canonical-source mechanisms, retaining the Deliverable A / A.1 deficiency, bounding the incidental HGP August 2026 audit, authorizing the Stage 2 Evolution Log entry, authorizing Draft v2 with individual disposition of the seventeen Stage 2 corrections and twelve priority tests, and authorizing the first structured stakeholder-evidence application with Founder Office as the accountable-authority stakeholder — external application, Method Library admission and software construction not authorized

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Systems Methodology — Stage 3 Completion Authorized, First Genuine Stakeholder Evidence Supplied
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 3: Stakeholder-Evidence Validation Completion execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), supplying the Founder Office's own answers to the thirty stakeholder questions as Client-Stated evidence, authorizing completion of the sealed records-versus-accounts comparison against independently retrieved records evidence, fixing the seven comparison classifications and the rule that neither records nor stakeholder testimony is automatically preferred, requiring contradictions to be preserved and any Founder statement that reads as a new determination to be identified rather than silently elevated, ordering post-test methodology corrections recorded as proposals only with frozen Draft v2 unaltered, capping the maturity claim at an internally tested provisional diagnostic with a remaining external-validation gap, and continuing every exclusion — external application, Method Library admission, standardization, software construction, pricing and commercial packaging not authorized

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Systems Methodology — Stage 3 Accepted and Closed, Stage 4 Authorized, Four Founder Clarifications Supplied
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 4: Correction Disposition, Clarification Integration & Draft v3 execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), accepting and closing Stage 3 as genuine internal validation evidence, fixing the method status at internally tested provisional diagnostic and expressly withholding the validated-through-use designation, supplying the Founder Office's own clarifications of Q3, Q14, Q18 and Q29 as Client-Stated evidence under a chronology rule that forbids erasing the original ambiguity, determining that Q8, Q12, Q13 and Q17 remain Client-Stated evidence and may not be elevated, closing the public-copy and fd-0006 questions without change, scoping the comparison re-run to Q18 alone within the seven existing classifications, requiring the diagnostic to distinguish sensemaking, clarification and routing from decision authority and the durable authoritative record without generalizing any Huerta mechanism, requiring authority concentration to be represented as an observed condition rather than a default, authorizing individual disposition of the ten Stage 3 correction proposals with the express rule that a Stage 3 recommendation is not adoption, and authorizing Draft v3 as a new organization-neutral provisional version — external application, Method Library admission, standardization, software construction, pricing and commercial packaging not authorized

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Systems Methodology — Stage 5 Authorized, Frozen Draft v3 Applied to Huerta Group Publishing
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 5: Internal Application of Frozen Draft v3 to Huerta Group Publishing execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), authorizing the first application of the diagnostic to a subject other than the parent, classifying Huerta Group Publishing as an internal subordinate organizational subject, imposing a freeze gate that verifies Draft v3 against its Stage 4 digest before application and forbids folding any correction into it during the test, authorizing a bounded re-run of the Q3, Q14 and Q29 comparison rows without altering the original answers, commissioning the narrowest truthful reporting treatment for one-sided evidence with any governed-semantics change returned rather than made, requiring the prior-familiarity limitation to be recorded before examination and forbidding any characterization of the work as blind, independent or external validation, forbidding every kind of change to the venture and the reproduction of unnecessary confidential venture substance, and withholding the validated-through-use designation — external application, Method Library admission, standardization and software construction not authorized

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Systems Methodology — Stage 5 Accepted and Closed, Stage 6 Second-Author Replication Authorized, D-8 Determined
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 6: Independent Second-Author Replication execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), accepting and closing Stage 5 while upholding the distinction between a complete methodology validation and an intentionally incomplete subject diagnosis, determining that every prior Generation One application provides internal testing evidence but not evaluator independence and that this qualifies rather than invalidates the evidence base, forbidding any rewriting of prior reports and any amendment of Draft v3 on that ground, adding the standing rule that a second author's independence statement is frozen before it receives substantive subject evidence, authorizing a reproducibility test by a separate authoring context isolated from thirteen classes of prior-application material under a no-coaching rule, requiring the second result to be sealed before any comparison, fixing seventeen comparison dimensions and eight difference classifications while prohibiting any reproducibility score, and capping what replication can establish at stronger internal reproducibility evidence — Draft v4, external application, Method Library admission, standardization and software construction not authorized

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Systems Methodology — Stage 6 Accepted and Closed, Stage 7 Consolidated Deficiency Disposition Authorized
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 7: Consolidated Methodology Deficiency Disposition execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), accepting and closing Stage 6 while recording that its reproducibility finding establishes neither external validity nor evaluator independence nor model-independent reproducibility, accepting as a finding that subject-diagnosis outputs reproduced more strongly than method-deficiency outputs while forbidding that finding to be read as invalidating either author's deficiencies, fixing the deficiency corpus at exactly thirty records to be adjudicated individually before any thematic consolidation, fixing five permitted dispositions and forbidding the use of resolved merely because a later draft could address an issue, fixing a six-part analytical order, preserving D-8 as a continuing evidence qualification that replication does not weaken and treating same-model-family agreement as correlated-error risk, classifying the Stage 6 evidence-boundary inequality as a replication-design deficiency rather than methodology disagreement, classifying the Stage 5 closure failure as a method-application defect while forbidding retroactive fabrication of the missing custody disposition, requiring a narrowest-rule answer for closure semantics and a four-option answer for one-sided evidence and a non-numeric mechanism for evidentiary sufficiency, and prohibiting creation of Draft v4, any further application, adoption, standardization, Method Library admission, software and every form of scoring

records.title: Founder Office Determinations: Organizational Diagnostic — Six Reserved Methodology Determinations (CS-01, CS-02, CS-03, CS-07, CS-12, CS-14)
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 8: Founder Office Determinations Recording & Consolidation Readiness execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), answering the six methodology questions the Stage 7 change set reserved at item level — approving a source-kind attribute that is categorical, descriptive, organization-neutral and non-ordinal and may never encode evidence quality; holding that A2 governs the diagnostic's own evidence classification while A1 governs the subject's terminology and neither erases the other; defining the diagnostic team as the actual institutional or individual actor performing the diagnostic and requiring disclosure of material prior involvement at both the institutional and individual layers while excluding incidental familiarity; retaining identity-of-record as a required output owned by A4, defining it as a sourced statement rather than a consultant-authored one, distinguishing Instrument 10 from the advancement action that returns questions, and requiring only that source-of-truth boundaries be sufficiently identified rather than institutionally established; permitting a subject diagnosis to close as an application record with a mandatory closure condition unsatisfied but forbidding its representation as an unqualified completed diagnosis and requiring a conspicuous unresolved-closure statement that is not a sixth outcome; and holding that Methodology Foundation v1 §7.5 does not travel by implication, that the full doctrine may not be duplicated, and that a conservative confidentiality default governs where it is not held — with the earlier five-question count corrected to six, the Stage 7 summary-count defect preserved rather than repaired, implementation detail declared future drafting jurisdiction rather than reopened authority, and Draft v4 construction not authorized

records.title: Founder Office Authorization: Organizational Diagnostic — Stage 9 Draft v4 Consolidation
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Stage 9: Draft v4 Consolidation execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), authorizing construction of Draft v4 as a bounded consolidation version built from Draft v3 as its substantive baseline and incorporating only the seventeen Stage 7 change-set items, their controlling dispositions, the six determinations at fd-0026, and strictly necessary internal-consistency edits — prohibiting an eighteenth substantive methodology change, new stages, new instruments, new evidence classes, scoring, maturity models, automation, software assumptions, external-client defaults, commercial framing, and both simplification and expansion untraceable to an authorized item; giving fd-0026 drafting precedence over narrower Stage 7 wording for CS-01, CS-03 and CS-14; requiring byte-identical verification of Drafts v1–v3 before and after construction with a stop rule if any digest fails and a prohibition on repairing a historical draft; classifying A10's conjunctive trail-first ambiguity as an open limitation and not a drafting discretion, to be disclosed and neither resolved by wording preference nor normalized away; fixing four evidence-inheritance classifications and forbidding any claim that a changed element is tested because its predecessor existed; requiring a bounded twenty-seven-point internal-consistency review that is expressly not behavioural validation; classifying Draft v4 as a provisional draft untested as a version and forbidding its elevation, its application to Huerta Group LLC or HGP, third-author replication, synthetic cases, fabricated evidence, and any label of tested derived from repository checks; and requiring only the smallest meaningful next validation stage to be recommended, with recommendation expressly not authorization

records.title: Founder Office Determination: Organizational Diagnostic — A10 Trail-First Semantics (Reading A Adopted)
records.instrument: Huerta Group Organizational Systems Methodology — Generation One — Post-Stage 9: A10 Reconciliation & Draft v4 Validation Package Preparation execution package (Founder Office → Institutional Platform Development), answering the A10 trail-first ambiguity Stage 7 returned as AMB-1 and Stage 9 preserved as Draft v4's sole unresolved limitation — adopting Reading A, under which the four listed items are categories of trail evidence to be pursued where they exist and are reasonably accessible rather than four mandatory limbs that must all be obtained before the procedure counts as performed; requiring for each materially relevant category that apparent existence, reasonable accessibility, actual obtention, and the reason for non-obtention be recorded, forbidding silent omission of a materially relevant source merely because another produced a plausible trail, and holding that prior familiarity is not trail evidence; fixing five conditions under which the procedure is performed and permitting performance with evidentiary gaps remaining; holding that a missing source bears on evidentiary sufficiency rather than voiding the procedure, that the missing source and its reason stay visible, and that missing evidence is never converted into an assumption that the absent source would have agreed; distinguishing the three existing Instrument 5 sufficiency values and forbidding automatic marking of artifact-derived trails as completed; holding that A10 does not determine advancement and that A10 performed with gaps and A18 unsatisfied is a permitted state; holding that a stakeholder walkthrough is not a universal per-workflow gate and that observation remains a preference rather than a fifth limb, while leaving stakeholder-evidence requirements elsewhere untouched; preserving Stage 5 and Stage 6 unchanged with neither author recharacterized as having applied the method incorrectly; authorizing only the minimum Draft v4 wording reconciliation with no new instrument, evidence class, hierarchy, scoring or maturity construct; and authorizing preparation but not execution of the smallest meaningful Draft v4 validation package — with an express stop rule requiring the repository-versioning question to be returned rather than chosen where existing governance cannot represent a same-version semantic reconciliation truthfully without creating Draft v5
